result.notes: Private-app API keys (HTTP Basic auth: email + API key) are obtainable directly from any Gorgias account (trial or paid) via account settings, no app review needed — this is the self-serve path most agent toolkits would use. Public/marketplace apps additionally require OAuth2 and are implied to need a listing process, but no explicit review/approval page was found in this pass (would need to check developers.gorgias.com/docs/set-up-oauth2-app-store for confirmation). Pricing page did not explicitly state which tiers include API access; rate limits (40-80 req/20s per third-party source) suggest it's broadly available rather than gated to a specific paid tier. No official vendor-published MCP server found; several community GitHub MCP servers and a Composio-wrapped toolkit (32 tools, api_key+oauth2) exist.
result.one_liner: Gorgias is an e-commerce-focused helpdesk/support platform with a REST API for tickets, customers, macros, and integrations.
